archivedPlanClosureBindingFailures.cause: these tests read an ARCHIVED execution plan and require its bound execution closure to equal the closure recomputed from the current tree
archivedPlanClosureBindingFailures.verifiedBy: a pristine-baseline experiment: with EVERY G1 change removed from src/, scripts/r3l0c_g1/, test/r3l0c_g1_* and research-evidence/r3-l0c-g1/, and dist rebuilt with tsc -b --force, the SAME 13 tests fail on the same 4 files
archivedPlanClosureBindingFailures.additionalCauseRecorded: the closure digest is computed over working-tree BYTES and depends on line-ending state and on the built dist/**; G0 recorded the same sensitivity, so the archived digests are bound to one specific checkout byte-state rather than to the commit alone
archivedPlanClosureBindingFailures.section10Quote: Because G1 may modify product Host/Work code, the resulting Closure will differ from the archived plan. That is expected. Do not run the archived experiment against G1 HEAD. Do not regenerate the archived Plan. Do not weaken the Closure Guard.
